description: Advisories present when the OSV gate was introduced (2026-10-03, osv-scanner 2.6.0 over the CycloneDX SBOM plus the resolved JARs), triaged on 2026-10-08. The OSV job in .github/workflows/security.yml fails for any advisory/package/version not listed here and for any entry whose 'expires' date has passed. Each entry carries status (affected, not-reachable, false-positive, accepted-risk, needs-review), reason, reviewed and expires; see scripts/check-osv-baseline.py. Remove entries as dependencies are upgraded; add one only after triage.

advisories.reason: Affected version on a production runtime classpath (Gradle resolution on 2026-10-08): vertx-core@4.5.11 in the runtimeClasspath of 11 module(s), e.g. :anchors:plugins:arbitrum via evm-base > core > crypto > tuweni-bytes. Fixed in 4.5.27, 5.0.12. Reachability from TrustWeave code is not individually assessed. Vert.x 4.5.11 arrives through web3j (tuweni); the fix is a newer web3j or a Vert.x pin.

Test infrastructure only: commons-compress@1.24.0 is pulled in by Testcontainers 1.21.4, which the testkit module exposes as an api dependency (runtime of testkit and distribution:examples, test classpaths elsewhere). No main source imports org.apache.commons.compress and it is on no production module's runtime classpath. Fixed in 1.26.0. Goes away with a Testcontainers upgrade.
